title: Remove 'Built with using caffeine.ai' footer from all pages

requirements.summary: Remove the 'Built with using caffeine.ai' footer text from all pages by searching and deleting any elements rendering this attribution in frontend layout and page components
acceptanceCriteria: No page in the application displays the text 'Built with using caffeine.ai' or any variation of it.
The footer element or container that held this text is also removed if it served no other purpose.
All pages — including the login page, dashboard, hospital finder, blood donor, volunteer, resource map, emergency contacts, and any other routes — are free of this attribution text.
No other visible content or layout is affected by the removal.

file_operations.description: Search the AppLayout component for any footer element or text node containing 'Built with using caffeine.ai' and remove it entirely. If a footer container exists solely for this attribution, remove the entire footer element. Ensure the layout structure remains intact after removal.

Search the LoginPage component for any footer element or text node containing 'Built with using caffeine.ai' and remove it entirely. If a footer container exists solely for this attribution, remove the entire footer element. Ensure no layout shifts or visual regressions occur.
Search the DashboardPage component for any footer or attribution text containing 'Built with using caffeine.ai' and remove it if present. Verify the page displays correctly without the attribution.
Search the HospitalFinderPage component for any footer or attribution text containing 'Built with using caffeine.ai' and remove it if present.
Search the BloodDonorPage component for any footer or attribution text containing 'Built with using caffeine.ai' and remove it if present.
Search the VolunteerPage component for any footer or attribution text containing 'Built with using caffeine.ai' and remove it if present.
Search the ResourceMapPage component for any footer or attribution text containing 'Built with using caffeine.ai' and remove it if present.
Search the EmergencyContactsPage component for any footer or attribution text containing 'Built with using caffeine.ai' and remove it if present.
